caption:
Akai just teased the new MPC Sample Key, but the real twist is the software. They are making it open source so creators and coders can hack and mod it however they want. Most brands lock their gear down, but Akai is letting users run wild. 🎹

Would you buy music gear you can recode yourself?

Source: The Verge

#Akai #MusicProduction #OpenSource #CreatorEconomy #MusicTech

post.news: Akai teased its new MPC Sample Key and plans to open-source its software so the community can hack it.
post.take: Akai basically handed over a keyboard and told the internet to finish building the software.
post.insight: Turning hardware into an open playground makes your community do the product development for you.
